CFTC Pressroom General Press Release http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ $urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Approves Cantor Futures Exchange, L.P. and Cantor Clearinghouse, L.P. Tue, 20 Apr 2010 21:10:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5811-10.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) approved the applications of Cantor Futures Exchange, L.P. for designation as a contract market and Cantor Clearinghouse, L.P. to be registered as a derivatives clearing organization.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC to Hold Public Meeting to Consider Significant Price Discovery Contract Determinations Mon, 19 Apr 2010 21:17:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5810-10.html The CFTC will meet on Tuesday, April 27, 2010, to consider whether contracts offered for trading on the IntercontinentalExchange, Inc. (ICE), the Natural Gas Exchange, Inc. (NGX) or the Chicago Climate Exchange, Inc. (CCX) perform significant price discovery functions.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Approves Media Derivatives, Inc. Designated Contract Market Application Fri, 16 Apr 2010 20:12:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5809-10.html CFTC approves the application of Media Derivatives, Inc. (MDEX) for designation as a contract market.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ Federal Regulators Release Model Consumer Privacy Notice Online Form Builder Thu, 15 Apr 2010 15:45:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5808-10.html Eight federal regulators released an Online Form Builder today that financial institutions can download and use to develop and print customized versions of a model consumer privacy notice.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Launches New Website Designed to Improve Access to Market and Agency Information Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5804-10.html The United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today launched a new website designed to enhance access to important market and agency information through CFTC.gov.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Approves Final Rules Creating a Separate Account Class for Customer Positions in Cleared OTC Derivatives Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5803-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) approved final rules (Final Rules) that enhance certainty regarding protections under the Bankruptcy Code and CFTC regulation Part 190 with respect to Over-the-Counter (OTC) derivatives (and related collateral) that customers clear through a futures commission merchant (FCM) on or subject to the rules of a derivatives clearing organization registered with the CFTC (cleared OTC derivatives).



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Announces Participants for Public Meeting to Examine Futures and Options Trading in the Metals Markets Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5798-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today announced the participants for its public meeting to examine the trading of futures and options in the precious and base metals markets.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Request From CME Clearing and NYMEX Involving Contracts Traded on the Dubai Mercantile Exchange Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5796-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (Commission) is requesting public comment on a petition submitted by the Clearing House Division of the Chicago Mercantile Exchange Inc. (CME Clearing) and the New York Mercantile Exchange Inc. (NYMEX) to amend an existing order in connection with contracts traded on the Dubai Mercantile Exchange (DME).



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Hosts International Regulators to Discuss Futures Industry Issues Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5792-10.html Futures services regulators from Brazil, Canada (Alberta, Manitoba, Ontario, and Quebec), Ethiopia, Germany, India, Japan, Mexico, Qatar, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Turkey, United Kingdom, and the United States will assemble today at an annual International Regulators Meeting hosted by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Chairman Gensler to Meet With Regulators to Discuss Critical Issues Related to Financial Regulatory Reform during Visits to Brussels and London Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5787-10.html Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Gary Gensler is scheduled to meet with various high-level financial services regulators in Brussels and London to discuss critical issues related to financial regulatory reform during the week of March 15 - 18.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC to Hold Public Meeting to Examine Futures and Options Trading in the Metals Markets Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5782-10.html United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) Chairman Gary Gensler today announced that the agency will hold a public meeting on March 25, 2010, to examine the trading of futures and options in the precious and base metals markets.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Releases Rule Enforcement Review of ICE Futures US Fri, 02 Apr 2010 04:00:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5780-10.html The Division of Market Oversight (Division) has notified ICE Futures US (ICE Futures or Exchange) of the results of a rule enforcement completed by the staff.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Grants ICE Clear Europe Limited Registration as Derivatives Clearing Organization Mon, 25 Jan 2010 18:47:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5775-10.html The CFTC issued an Order on Friday, January 22, 2010, granting ICE Clear Europe Limited registration as a derivatives clearing organization (DCO) pursuant to Section 5b(b) of the Commodity Exchange Act.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC’s Division of Clearing and Intermediary Oversight Provides Annual Report Guidance to Commodity Pool Operators Fri, 22 Jan 2010 20:29:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5774-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Intermediary Oversight has issued its annual guidance letter to registered commodity pool operators.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Announces Inclusion of ICE Henry Hub SPDC Contract Data in Weekly Commitments of Traders Reports Tue, 19 Jan 2010 15:24:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5773-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announced on Friday, January 15, 2010, that it will include positions in the IntercontinentalExchange (ICE) Henry Hub natural gas contract in its weekly Commitments of Traders (COT) reports.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Proposed Regulations Regarding Retail FOREX Transactions Wed, 13 Jan 2010 20:17:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5772-10.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) announced the publication in the Federal Register of proposed regulations concerning off-exchange retail foreign currency transactions.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC to Hold Open Meeting on a Proposed Position Limits Rule Thu, 14 Jan 2010 18:09:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5771-10.html The United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) will hold a public meeting on Thursday, January 14, 2009, to consider issuance of a proposed rule on energy position limits and hedge exemptions on regulated futures exchanges, derivatives transaction execution facilities and electronic trading facilities.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Revised Petition From the Chicago Mercantile Exchange Involving Credit Default Swaps Wed, 06 Jan 2010 20:49:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5770-10.html The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is requesting public comment on a revised petition submitted by the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) in connection with credit default swaps (CDS) cleared by CME.



$urlvar=//www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/ Commodity Futures Trading Commission Releases Staff Report on Cotton Futures and Option Market Activity During the Week of March 3, 2008 Tue, 05 Jan 2010 18:01:00 UTC http://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/pr5769-10.html The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) today released a staff report on cotton futures and option market activity during the week of March 3, 2008.
